dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The posterior-dorsal region exhibits several irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings with diffuse outer perimeters that transition through a soft gradient into darker, recessed central cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, irregular high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated along the lower lateral flank and interspersed between the macro-annuli on the rear third of the visible torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-posterior section form a distinct scalene triangle with the longest axis oriented parallel to the dorsal ridge.
